batch_notes: Batch E06 (creatures, 78 items): 78 entries. Kept 18: NARC (only member 17946), Arachnophobia, two dragon-fall mods (156824 try and 56317 alt in group dragon_fall), Horse Storage, Iconic's werebeasts, Slaughterfish RTX, True Hunter, Higher Poly dragon skeleton plus the two Whiterun spike members, DVA (try, likely DLL), Hovels of Hagravens LessPoly, Sanguine Sundries, Undead summons emerge, Zim's Dremora, UBM patch, Dragon Stalking Fix, Rally's Dragons Tongue. The rest were dropped as covered by the stack, excluded categories, new-creature content, or low value. No WebSearch used; VR status comes from card data and knowledge, so unknown where a plugin might ship a DLL.
